data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basmaat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بسمات
in_arabic.meaning: بسمات تعني الابتسامة أوالفرحة في الوجه

in_urdu.name: بسامات
in_urdu.meaning: بسامات کا مطلب مسکراہٹ یا چہرے پر خوشی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: بسامات ایک نام ہے جو بسم فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب مسکراہٹ یا چہرے پر خوشی ہے۔ یہ فعل قرآن مجید میں سورة النمل آية 19 میں ذکر ہوا ہے۔ بسامات نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی قدرت اور خلق کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बस्मात
in_hindi.meaning: बस्मात का अर्थ है मुस्कराहट या चेहरे पर खुशी
in_hindi.long_meaning: बस्मात नाम बिस्मिल शब्द से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मुस्कराहट या चेहरे पर खुशी। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की शक्ति और रचना का प्रतीक है। बस्मात नाम की लड़कियाँ मुस्कराहट और मिठास से भरी होती हैं।

in_pashto.name: بسامت
in_pashto.meaning: بسامت د مسکراهټ یا په مخ کې د خوښۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: بسامت نوم د بسم فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د مسکراهټ یا په مخ کې د خوښۍ معنی لري. دا فعل د قرآن کریم په سورة النمل آية 19 کې ذکر شوی دی. بسامت نوم د افغانستان په اسلامی ثقافت کې مهم دی ځکه چې دا د الله تعالی قدرت او خلق کولو نښه ده.

in_english.name: Basmaat
in_english.meaning: Basmaat means smile or joy on the face
in_english.long_meaning: Basmaat is a name derived from the Arabic root 'b-s-m', which means smile or joy on the face. This root is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah An-Naml, Verse 19. The name Basmaat holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing happiness, and divine blessings. It reflects the values of joy, positivity, and warmth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Basmaat holds a significant cultural impact, as it is symbolic of joy, happiness, and positivity. In various Islamic communities, the name is often bestowed upon newborn girls to signify the desire for a sunny disposition and a pleasant demeanor that can bring a smile to people's faces. The name may also reflect the admiration and love for those who have a magnetic and uplifting personality that inspires happiness and positive energy in others.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name Basmaat carries a profound spiritual significance, representing the manifestation of the divine light and love within an individual. Just as a morning sunbasms the world into existence and brings life and joy, the name Basmaat signifies the inner light and radiance of a soul that illuminates the world and touches the hearts of others. It is a reminder of the sacred responsibility of each soul to shine brightly and bring joy to others, fostering a sense of unity, compassion, and love within the community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Smile, Radiant, Glowing" symbolizes The one who brings a smile, radiant, glowing. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Basmaat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of smile, radiant, glowing.
